expectations.text: The skill reads BOTH rules files before classifying
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows 'Found two rules files: .claude/rules/ui-rules.md and .claude/rules/code-rules.md' and presents a pre-edit inventory for both files separately before any classification work begins.

expectations.text: Pre-classification budget report shows aggregated totals: 12 T3, 2 critical, 3 scopeless across both files
expectations.evidence: Transcript 'Cross-file totals (before)' table shows: Total T3 = 12, Critical T3 = 2, Scopeless T3 = 3, matching the assertion exactly.

expectations.text: 'Test files must not import from other test files' is classified as T1 (regex on import paths)
expectations.evidence: Transcript states 'Classification: T1 (deterministic)' with reasoning 'A regex or lint rule can match import paths containing .test or .spec within test files.' Output code-rules.md confirms tier: T1 with pattern: "import .* from ['\"].*\\.(test|spec)['\"]".

expectations.text: 'Components must not exceed 200 lines' is classified as T1 (line count is syntactic)
expectations.evidence: Transcript states 'Classification: T1 (deterministic)' with reasoning 'This is a hard numeric threshold — 200 lines. A lint rule or script can count lines in component files.' Output code-rules.md confirms tier: T1 with pattern: "file line count > 200".

expectations.text: Post-classification budget report includes T3 counts from ui-rules.md even though only code-rules.md was edited
expectations.evidence: Transcript 'Cross-file totals (after)' shows Total T3 going from 12 to 13, where 12 includes ui-rules.md's 8 T3 rules. The post-edit aggregate is correctly computed across both files, not just the edited code-rules.md.

expectations.text: The per-file breakdown is shown alongside the aggregated totals
expectations.evidence: The pre-edit section shows both per-file breakdowns (ui-rules.md and code-rules.md) alongside aggregate totals. However, the post-edit section only shows a per-file breakdown for code-rules.md — ui-rules.md has no post-edit per-file row. The cross-file aggregate is shown, but without a complete per-file breakdown for both files in the post-classification report.
